title: Vitthāro
text: 2. pañcimāni bhikkhave indriyāni || katamāni pañca || || Saddhindriyaṃ || la-pe || paññindriyaṃ || || Imāni kho bhikkhave pañcindriyāni || || 3. Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannam indriyānaṃ samattā paripūrattā arahaṃ hoti || tato mudatarehi antarāparinibbāyī- -saddhānusārī hoti || || 4. Iti kho bhikkhave paripūraṃ paripūrakārī ārādheti || padesam padesakārī ārādheti avañjhānitvevāham bhikkhave pañcindriyāni vadamīti || ||
